t: Shop Spotlight: TC Gakki, Tokyo's Used Gear Capital | Reverb News
s: December 11, 2023 - Located in Shin-Ōkubo, just a stop away from Tokyo's busy Shinjuku station, lies the musical instrument mecca of TC Gakki. Over the course of its 30-year history, hundreds of thousands of instruments have passed through its doors. It's often regarded as one of the best places to go, whether you're searching for player-grade vintage or an ultra-rare model. Buying, selling, sometimes trading—TC Gakki is all about used instruments.
